attempts.url: no vendor OpenAPI; Google Drive API v3 publishes a Discovery document

notes: Full coverage of the Google Drive API v3, converted from the verbatim Google API Discovery document (revision 20261117) committed as upstream.json. Every resource method (64 operations) plus the media-upload endpoints of the 2 methods that take file content (4 operations: the simple /upload/... and resumable /resumable/upload/... paths, absolute from rootUrl) and every Discovery schema (54 components) is modelled. The googledrive adaptor calls this API through the googleapis SDK; the whole API is described here (not just the adaptor's operations) so a workflow can reach any endpoint via the generic builders.
